final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. The vendored `slugify` deletes any character outside `a-z` before it can map accents, so the wrapper now decomposes the title (NFD), removes the combining accent marks, and then calls `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the same vendored `slugify` directly, so product URLs with accented names will drop those letters too. I left it alone because it's outside this fix. If you want it fixed, the same normalization would work there. I didn't commit anything.
